title: Kosakata Rutinitas Harian
subtitle: wake up, get up, brush teeth, take a bath
objectives: Membedakan wake up dan get up

stages.name: Pembuka
stages.teacher_script: Selamat pagi! Kemarin kita belajar penghubung waktu. Hari ini kita akan belajar lebih banyak kosakata rutinitas harian: dari bangun tidur sampai tidur lagi. Pernahkah kalian ingin bercerita detail tentang hari kalian tapi kekurangan kata? Hari ini kita akan tambah kosakatanya. Tujuan kita: kalian bisa menyebut minimal 15 kegiatan rutinitas harian dalam bahasa Inggris. Kita mulai dari teori kosakata rutinitas, latihan, dialog, lalu rangkuman. Siap? Mari mulai!
stages.instructions: Sapa dan tanya: 'What do you do every day?'. Tulis 15 kata kerja rutinitas di papan dengan gambar ilustrasi. Perkenalkan tujuan kelas.

stages.name: Teori
stages.content:
## Kosakata Rutinitas Harian

Berikut kosakata kata kerja yang sering dipakai untuk membicarakan rutinitas harian, dari pagi sampai malam.

### Kegiatan Pagi

| Inggris | Indonesia | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| wake up | bangun tidur | I wake up at 6. |
| get up | turun dari tempat tidur | I get up at 6:05. |
| take a shower | mandi | I take a shower at 6:10. |
| brush teeth | gosok gigi | I brush my teeth. |
| wash face | cuci muka | I wash my face. |
| get dressed | berpakaian | I get dressed. |
| have breakfast | sarapan | I have breakfast at 6:30. |
| go to school | pergi ke sekolah | I go to school at 7. |
| go to work | pergi bekerja | Dad goes to work at 7. |

### Kegiatan Siang

| Inggris | Indonesia | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| study | belajar | I study English. |
| have lunch | makan siang | I have lunch at noon. |
| take a break | istirahat | We take a break. |
| catch a bus | naik bus | I catch a bus. |
| walk to school | jalan kaki ke sekolah | I walk to school. |

### Kegiatan Sore/Malam

| Inggris | Indonesia | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| go home | pulang | I go home at 3. |
| do homework | mengerjakan PR | I do my homework. |
| play | bermain | I play with friends. |
| have dinner | makan malam | We have dinner at 7. |
| watch TV | nonton TV | I watch TV at night. |
| read a book | membaca buku | I read before bed. |
| listen to music | dengarkan musik | She listens to music. |
| go to bed / sleep | tidur | I go to bed at 9. |

### Frasa Pendukung

- *have breakfast/lunch/dinner* — sarapan/makan siang/makan malam (pakai **have**, bukan **eat** untuk konteks formal)
- *go to school/work* — pergi ke sekolah/bekerja (pakai **to**)
- *go to bed* — tidur (pakai **to bed**)
- *do homework* — mengerjakan PR (pakai **do**)

### Contoh Paragraf Rutinitas Lengkap

*I wake up at 6 a.m. every day. First, I get up and take a shower. Then, I brush my teeth and wash my face. After that, I have breakfast with my family. I go to school at 7. I study until noon and have lunch. After school, I go home at 3 p.m. I do my homework, then play with my friends. We have dinner at 7 p.m. After dinner, I watch TV or read a book. Finally, I go to bed at 9 p.m.*

### Mini-Dialog Contoh

**Dialog 1:**
- A: What time do you wake up?
- B: I wake up at 6 a.m.
- A: And when do you go to bed?
- B: I go to bed at 9 p.m.

**Dialog 2:**
- A: What do you do after school?
- B: I go home, do my homework, and then play.
- A: Do you watch TV at night?
- B: Yes, I watch TV for an hour.

> **Hindari:** Jangan menulis 'take breakfast' (harusnya *have breakfast* atau *eat breakfast*). Jangan 'go to bed sleep' (pilih salah satu: *go to bed* atau *sleep*). Jangan lupa *do* dalam *do homework* (bukan *make homework*).

### Cara Mengucapkan

- **wake up** /weɪk ʌp/
- **take a shower** /teɪk ə ˈʃaʊər/
- **brush teeth** /brʌʃ tiːθ/
- **go to school** /ɡoʊ tuː skuːl/
- **do homework** /duː ˈhoʊmwɜːrk/
- **go to bed** /ɡoʊ tuː bed/

### Tips

1. Hafalkan kata kerja rutinitas pagi-siang-malam.
2. Pakai *have* untuk makan (have breakfast/lunch/dinner).
3. Pakai *do* untuk homework (do homework).
key_points: Kegiatan pagi: wake up, get up, take a shower, brush teeth, wash face, get dressed, have breakfast
Kegiatan siang: study, have lunch, take a break, catch a bus, walk to school
Kegiatan sore/malam: go home, do homework, play, have dinner, watch TV, read, go to bed
go to bed / go to sleep (alternatif untuk tidur)
Kata kerja rutinitas bisa dikombinasikan dengan always, usually, every day
Urutan ideal: wake up → shower → breakfast → school → home → dinner → bed

stages.name: Latihan
stages.instructions: Lakukan 5 latihan berurutan. (1) **Drill:** murid mengulang 15 kata kerja rutinitas 2x setelah guru. (2) **Tebak kata:** guru memperagakan kegiatan, murid menebak kata Inggrisnya. (3) **Isian:** 'I ___ at 6. I ___ my teeth. I ___ breakfast. I ___ to school.' (4) **Role play:** dua murid saling menceritakan rutinitas harinya dengan 8 kata kerja. (5) **Koreksi:** tulis di papan 'I take breakfast. I make homework. I go bed.' (salah preposisi/kata kerja), minta murid memperbaiki.

stages.name: Penutup
stages.teacher_script: Bagus! Hari ini kita belajar 15+ kata kerja rutinitas harian, dari wake up sampai go to bed. Yang paling penting: have breakfast/lunch/dinner (bukan take), do homework (bukan make), dan go to bed (untuk tidur). Pertanyaan untuk kalian: bagaimana menyebut 'sarapan' dalam Inggris? Dan 'mengerjakan PR'? Untuk PR, tulis rutinitas harimu dengan 10 kata kerja berbeda. Besok kita akan belajar preposisi pendukung: at, in, on untuk tempat. Sampai jumpa!
stages.instructions: Rangkum kosakata rutinitas. Tanyakan 2 pertanyaan pemahaman. Tulis PR di papan. Tutup dengan 'See you tomorrow!'
